advisory.title: Advisory matters
advisory.introduction: Read the engagement model, delivery practices and matter economics together. Contractual terms and external execution retain their stated limits.

assets.title: Identity and artwork
assets.introduction: Find the approved identity sources and their use boundaries. Reusing a mark does not authorize a new variant or change its source authority.

audit.title: Audit evidence
audit.introduction: Use the export contract to understand a unit’s evidence population, formats and reconciliation scope before selecting samples.

blackridge.title: Blackridge case
blackridge.introduction: Keep the 2015 Blackridge case separate from Sable Harbor’s company history and books. Match the dataset profile, period and version to the exercise.

business-lines.title: Business dossiers
business-lines.introduction: Read what each business produces, how its work moves and which financial and control records support it. Business-line relationships and legal ownership remain distinct.

canon.title: Canon and decisions
canon.introduction: These records preserve accepted decisions and their explicit supersession scope. Read dates and status before using an older narrative as current authority.

controls.title: Controls and assurance
controls.introduction: Follow control scope, evidence populations and review boundaries. A framework mapping or generated procedure is not an assurance conclusion.

enterprise.title: Enterprise models and services
enterprise.introduction: Read business, operating, service and runtime models with their release and readiness boundaries. Synthetic design is distinct from an operating estate.

finance.title: Finance and accounting
finance.introduction: Start with the evidence guide or a worked exercise, then use the accounting and model documentation for the selected population. Conditional forecasts and historical reconstructions remain separate.

geospatial.title: Places and facilities
geospatial.introduction: Inspect sites, buildings, floor plans and geographic evidence with their precision and occupancy limits. A planned or illustrative location is not a surveyed property right.

governance.title: Governance and authority
governance.introduction: Read the Board, committee and enterprise doctrines to understand who decides, who supports and who independently reviews. Dated approvals remain specific to their recorded scope.

industrial.title: Industrial cases
industrial.introduction: Follow operating constraints, acquisition decisions and historical alternatives across the industrial cases. Preserve the selected scenario and the distinction between an opportunity and an acquired asset.

internal.title: Catalog and source tools
internal.introduction: Use the catalog guide to query and trace the archive. An index helps locate a record; it does not add authority to that record.

j2.title: J2 and institutional memory
j2.introduction: Read the intelligence, judgment, orientation and learning doctrines alongside Alexandria’s records and disclosure boundaries. Institutional support does not confer executive authority.

organization.title: People and organization
organization.introduction: Read chart rosters and source qualifications alongside the images. Named people, authorized billets, business lines and legal entities are different populations and relationships.

reader.title: Practical reading and exercises
reader.introduction: Choose a bounded exercise, locate its supporting records and state the limits of the result. The source and format guides explain how to compare different representations.

red_wash.title: Red Wash records
red_wash.introduction: Read the mining case with its operating, financial and transaction boundaries. Logistics availability does not remove uranium custody or qualification gates.

reference.title: Document reference
reference.introduction: Use the controlled index to locate formal source and publication pairs. Compare version and status before relying on an edition.

releases.title: Release packages
releases.introduction: Use indexed releases for complete, versioned exercise packages. Retain the guide, manifest and checksums with a downloaded dataset.

tools.title: Publication tools
tools.introduction: These records describe how the reading edition is exported, checked and published. The repository remains the source of truth for editorial and generated content.
